scope: offline development eligibility; not independent production certification

support.interpretation: Reporting support floor, not independent sample size or confidence guarantee; unique-day units from existing A.2 diagnosis, not overlapping target sums.

categoryAndSegment.scope: category and original demand-segment families evaluated separately; unsupported groups never count as ordinary passes

priority.membership: union of top10 lists selected by TRAIN-only revenue in the three folds; evaluate those SKU in all folds

selection.primary: lowest pooled WAPE among quality-eligible causal ML recipes
selection.nearTieRule: among recipes within 1% of best pooled WAPE, fewer fitted estimators, then lower profiled warm p95, artifact bytes, lexical name; unknown timing sorts last
selection.noEligible: do not select a rejected model or run further experiments

operational.newSkuAdditionalCondition: must be covered by a newly accepted artifact/validated inference contract; 29 dates alone do not certify unknown-SKU quality
operational.bundleCoherence: must have existing audited evidence or subsequent focal validation; no new predictions/metrics generated here
operational.failedCandidate: keep previous ACTIVE; without ACTIVE ML, stay explicitly transitional/not ML-compliant, do not rename MA28

rationale.global: Retain existing global margins; pool errors rather than arithmetic-average ratios. Paired majority plus latest non-inferiority and per-fold limits prevents a single high-volume fold hiding drift.
rationale.local: Keep ordinary 10% group and 20% SKU tolerances. Replace unanimity with fixed exception budgets: at least 4/5 groups, 9/10 target volume, 8/10 priority SKU and nonpositive median priority deterioration.
rationale.catastrophic: An increase of one half in error or signed volume imbalance is a fixed red line above ordinary tolerance, not an estimate optimized to outcomes. These are conservative provisional risk budgets for a synthetic academic scenario, not statistically derived universal constants or verified commercial cost tolerances.
rationale.postSelection: All outcomes were previously seen. Freeze prevents further outcome-dependent edits but cannot remove selection bias. Eligibility is exploratory; no p-values, confidence or unbiased generalization claims.
